api_list.name: Get UserInfo (including HD profile picture)
api_list.description: Get the full-resolution profile picture url, profile links, biography, internal information and more
api_list.code:
import requests

url = "https://instagram-api-media-downloader.p.rapidapi.com/ig/userInfoByUsername/mileycyrus"

headers = {
            "X-RapidAPI-Key": "SIGN-UP-FOR-KEY",
            "X-RapidAPI-Host": "instagram-api-media-downloader.p.rapidapi.com"
        }

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
print(response.json())
